editorial:
Imagine you are on a dream vacation with your best friends in a foreign city, just trying to have a good time. Everything feels great until one person makes a tiny, silly mistake that they do not even think twice about. Suddenly, the trip turns into a total nightmare as the group finds themselves hunted by something truly evil. You get to follow these five young adults as they scramble to stay alive in a place where they do not know the rules and cannot trust anyone around them. The vibe is tense and scary, making you feel like you are right there with them as the panic sets in.

What really works here is how the action keeps moving without slowing down too much. The acting is decent for this kind of flick, and the twists keep you guessing about who is actually trying to help. While some parts feel a bit predictable, it is still a fun ride if you love survival stories. You should definitely try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or maybe rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a physical media fan, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your collection is a great way to keep this thriller handy.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a shocking twist when you find out that the stranger who seemed to be helping the group was actually the one controlling the horror all along. After a brutal fight for survival, the remaining characters realize they were just pawns in a sick game. Most of the group does not make it out, and the film closes on a dark note, showing that evil usually wins when you trust the wrong person.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival horror and unexpected twists.
